# Functional coverage map

> Generated by `tests/uat/coverage-map.mjs` from the files named above. Edit the generator or its inputs and regenerate; changes made here are overwritten.

For each of the 176 requirements: its assessment status, the test files its evidence-map entry cites (counted by layer), the catalogue cases that name it (counted by type), how many of those are formally executed, and three gap flags. Full per-requirement rows are in [coverage.csv](coverage.csv).

## Read this first

- **A cited test file is context, not acceptance.** The evidence map (`requirements/evidence-map.json`) lists files related to a requirement. It does not say that a test checks the requirement's acceptance criterion, and no number here is a completion percentage. All 176 BRD acceptances are pending.
- **71 of 176 requirements have no entry of their own** in the evidence map and inherit the list of their area (for example every BR-UX requirement shows the same files). For those, the counts below describe the area, not the requirement. The `evidenceEntry` column in the CSV says which is which.
- **The map is incomplete in both directions.** 61 of 236 test files on disk are cited by no requirement (listed below), so "no automated test cited" overstates the gap: for example the ABDM contract and integration tests exist, yet BR-INT-13, BR-INT-15, BR-INT-18 and BR-INT-19 cite none. Conversely, citing a broad suite such as `tests/api-smoke.mjs` makes a requirement look covered when that suite may check little about it.
- **Formal execution is 0 of 364 catalogue cases.** A case counts only when its row in docs/testing/uat/uat-results.csv is a Pass or Fail executed by a named person and reviewed by a different one, with build, actual result and evidence or defect (strategy 07). Unit, integration and resilience assertions do not count. Every catalogue record still says Not run.
- **Counts are files, not assertions**, and say nothing about whether a test passes today. Assessment audit date: 2026-09-30 (requirements/audit-meta.json); statuses are read from requirements/assessment.tsv as committed.
- **22 test files exist under tests/smoke/, tests/ui/ or tests/nfr/ at this commit.** Other round-11 slices add them. The ui and nfr rows below come from the existing audits classified by name (see Layer rules). A suite added later changes the "files on disk" column but not a requirement's counts until the evidence map cites it; the integrator owns that file.

## Layer rules

Applied to the paths the evidence map cites (`layerOf` in `tests/lib/uat-data.mjs`). Anything that is not a `.mjs` or `.js` file under `tests/` (documents, source, saved JSON evidence) is not counted as a test file.

| Path | Layer |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/smoke/**` | smoke |
| `tests/ui/**` | ui |
| `tests/nfr/**` | nfr |
| `tests/*-smoke.mjs` (HTTP and D1 suite modules, run by `tests/api-smoke.mjs`) | integration |
| any other `tests/*.mjs` (contract, client, field-shell, ehr-execution, mis-delivery and similar) | unit |
| `tests/recovery-drill.mjs` (encrypted restore drill) | resilience |
| `tests/a11y-audit.mjs` (browser accessibility audit, run outside CI) | ui |
| `tests/load-envelope.mjs` (load envelope measurement) | nfr |
| `tests/adapter-overhead-bench.mjs` (adapter overhead benchmark) | nfr |
| `tests/scheduled-local-check.mjs` (serves the built Worker and calls its scheduled handler) | integration |
| `tests/run-api-smoke.mjs` (runner for tests/api-smoke.mjs, not a suite) | not a suite, ignored |
| `tests/database-fixtures.mjs` (fixture helper, not a suite) | not a suite, ignored |

`tests/lib/`, `tests/uat/`, `tests/reports/` and `tests/evidence/` are never counted.

## Every requirement

Layer columns count distinct cited files. Cases: F functional, N negative or recovery, P performance or control, E end to end. Exec is formally executed cases. UAT is cases in the UAT scripts.
